The main frame displays a mobile MOBA game screen (Arena of Valor). She looks intently at her device, her mouth moving as she speaks while her character moves through a green jungle environment. (2) The scene cuts between different gameplay moments. The woman's facial expressions change rapidly from concentration to surprise. Large, colorful text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear frequently in the center of the screen, reacting to the game events. (3) The gameplay intensifies with combat effects like circles and flashes on the screen. The woman leans back and laughs heartily, showing her teeth and squinting her eyes. She is holding a smartphone horizontally. (4) The woman leans forward again, shouting excitedly as her character engages in a chaotic team fight. The background of the game is a dark, rocky arena. (5) She leans back once more, laughing and gesturing with her hands while still holding the phone. The game screen shows her character's defeat or a comedic moment, accompanied by even more expressive text overlays.
